generalisation_verdict: INDETERMINATE — feature pipeline incompatibility prevents valid measurement
diagnostic_note: External AUC=0.0 is a feature pipeline incompatibility artifact, NOT a biological finding. Training features (GEO GSE149438) are discretised at 0.01 resolution (consistent with ~100 reads per sample), while our Nextflow pipeline extracts smooth continuous histograms from 350K+ aligned fragments. After scaling with the training scaler: training-test features range [-2.58, +14.46], external features range [-12.76, +2.61]. The model receives out-of-distribution inputs and defaults to P(cancer)≈0.999 for all samples (the majority class at 84.7% in training). Additionally, n=3 is statistically insufficient for AUC estimation regardless of the pipeline mismatch. Valid external validation requires features extracted with the same pipeline as the training data, OR retraining on labelled BAM-derived features.
data_note: External features: 1M-read-pair subsample (~15-25% depth) from PRJNA291063 FASTQs aligned to hg38 with BWA-MEM. Fragment lengths from TLEN field. 150 bins, 100-400bp, normalised to sum=1.
